confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are more certain than accommodation, which varies by season and district. Cocktail and wine use the local relationship to beer where direct knowledge is weak. Values reflect July high-season demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned against nearby Balkan and Central European capitals of similar size and tourism profile, such as Sofia and Budapest, with a July high-season uplift for accommodation. No comparable-city price table was consulted.
